name: WhatsApp Bulk Activity Check
description: Registration status plus last-active time, active days and the Business flag, so you can tell live numbers from dormant ones across a whole list.

result_fields.name: activated
result_fields.description: Whether the number is registered on WhatsApp.

result_fields.name: business
result_fields.description: Whether this is a WhatsApp Business account.

result_fields.name: activetime
result_fields.description: The most recent activity time observed.

result_fields.name: activedays
result_fields.description: Days since that activity — smaller is more recent.
